summary_1line: After their mother Kadru's curse, Vasuki gathers the serpents to debate schemes to stop King Janamejaya’s future snake‑sacrifice that threatens their extinction.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vasuki, king of the serpents, coils upon a rocky seat while countless snakes gather around him in a dim cavern council.
A chaotic assembly of serpents argue—some rearing with fangs bared, others coiled calmly—while plotting ways to sabotage a royal sacrifice.
The great serpent Vasuki lowers his hood in troubled thought as the multitude of snakes watch him, awaiting his decision.
